name: cognitience-pp
description: Cognitience PP — local-first presentation app with liquid glass UI and Rust backend
author: Cognitience

scripts.native: cargo build --release && cargo build --release --manifest-path native-host/Cargo.toml && powershell -NoProfile -Command "Start-Process -FilePath (Resolve-Path 'native-host/target/release/cognition-pp-native.exe') -WindowStyle Normal"
scripts.native:headless: cargo build --release && cargo build --release --manifest-path native-host/Cargo.toml && set COGNITION_NATIVE_HEADLESS_SECS=20&& native-host\target\release\cognition-pp-native.exe --headless
